ashwin: Attempting prod deploy for release v2026-03-20-rc1, deploy-bot blocked: MFA missing for deployers group. Who can press? :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: PermissionDenied: user ashwin has no enrolled MFA. To proceed, request JIT via `/jit-request` and have an approver grant 'deploy' role. See https://runbook/release/jit 

maya: I can approve but I'm off rota until 21:00 UTC. If this is urgent we should pin and let a different approver handle.

sre-oncall: I can approve a short window. @jess are you available to accept temporary deployer role?

jess: Yep, I can accept for 30m. But we should pin to the last stable canary (v1.43.2). Don't roll forward to rc builds while we triage.

ashwin: Agreed. Willn't try rc1. Need to pin and then re-run deploy. Commands I'll use after approval:

```
/deploy pin --release v1.43.2 --env prod --reason "prevent rc1 regressions during emergency hotfix"
/deploy start --release v1.43.2 --env prod --strategy canary:10
```

jess: :thumbsup: Go ahead. I'm granting now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: JIT grant request received. Approver jess granted 'deploy' role to ashwin for 30 minutes. Audit id: audit-20260320-83. Grant expires in 30m.

ashwin: Re-running deploy now. If we see latency spike >150ms or error_rate >0.5% we'll rollback. Tagging #oncall-metrics for traces.

samir: If rollback needed, revert to v1.43.1 with:

```
/deploy rollback --to v1.43.1 --env prod --reason "regression in rc1"
```

ashwin: Noted. Canary started.

[deploy logs]
[deploy] canary 10% -> health checks passing, new pods boot ok

sre-oncall: Added 15m extra scraping and an alert if p95 latency > 150ms or error_rate > 0.5%.

jess: :white_check_mark: Approved and monitoring. After deploy finishes I'll revoke the temp grant.

ashwin: Canary healthy. Rolling to 100%.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deploy complete. release pinned to v1.43.2. Audit id audit-20260320-83. Temporary grant revoked. Closing thread. :lock:
